planner_finish.summary:
SOLVED in one episode (terminated=true at step 24) on libero_10 task 2, seed 0: "turn on the stove and put the moka pot on it".

Phase 1 — stove on: used pi0_pick as a closed-loop CONTACT skill (prompt "turn the stove knob", lift_thresh 999, gripper_closed_thresh 0). In 5 chunks it reached the knob at (-0.183, 0.215, 0.938), closed on the lever and rotated it; the hot-plate coil rings turned bright red (stove ON) — confirmed in RGB.

Phase 2 — the hard part, grasping the pot. The pot's handle is a closed loop whose bar sat at z 0.975-1.03 on a 13cm-tall upright pot. Every handle hook (pi0_pick, and scripted move_pose with pitch 0.45/0.9 at yaw 0 and 90) stalled at eef z~1.04-1.055. I calibrated the fingertips from the wrist world map and found the pads sit essentially AT the eef height (eef_z+0.006), so the bar was physically unreachable from above. A diagnostic descent at x=-0.015 and at (0.033, +0.10) then proved the "wall" was NOT an IK limit (the eef reached z=0.950 at x=0.033 once clear of the pot) — the pot itself was the obstruction. The pot got knocked onto its side during those attempts, which was lucky: a lying cylinder is an easier target.

Phase 3 — re-localized the tipped pot from scratch (agentview/wrist region + point back_project): axis from base (0.029, 0.074, 0.976) to cap end (-0.044, -0.037, 0.942), diameter 4.2cm at the cap growing to 7.6cm at the base. Derived the correct cross-diameter gripper yaw = 0.99 rad (a first try at 2.154 was 33° off and put a fingertip on the pot's top), descended onto the narrow upper chamber, and closed: the opening settled at a 6.7cm finger gap = exactly the pot's local diameter, with the wrist image showing the pot's white body pressed between both pads. Lifted it clean off the table.

Phase 4 — carried with gripper:+1 on measured held-offsets (pot base 9.2cm from the grip along (0.52, 0.855)) in two sub-0.20m waypoints so the pot's centre landed at (-0.068, 0.191), i.e. 1.8cm from the coil centre (-0.062, 0.208), then lowered it; the goal predicate fired on touchdown at eef z=0.9965, before a release was even required.

Audit and 24-step recipe JSONL written to the episode directory. No reset was used.
